question: Which published claims are stamped `documented`?
method: records with kind=wire and stamp=documented. `documented` maps to the prose tier `documented_fact`; the stamp governs how the claim may be restated, not how important it is.

results.title: Trump has directed the Pentagon to reduce the scale of joint military exercises with South Korea.
Trump announced the decision in a social media post, saying the exercises slated to begin this week are costly.
South Korea's president has proposed talks with Pyongyang aimed at formally ending the Korean War and replacing the armistice.

Trump's announcement came a day after the United States pulled its last aircraft carrier in Asia, with the USS George Washington sent to replace the USS Abraham Lincoln in the Persian Gulf, NBC News reported on 16 August 2026.

North Korea on Friday 14 August 2026 threatened unspecified stern steps against the United States and South Korea, describing the drills as a rehearsal for an aggressive war that was triggering greater instability in the region.

US and South Korean forces were expected to practise joint operations in complex scenarios during Ulchi Freedom Shield, including a live-fire exercise testing joint precision targeting and manoeuvre, a wet gap crossing, and distribution of prepositioned military equipment.

Earlier in August 2026 South Korea, the United States and Japan detected the launch of a short-range ballistic missile from North Korea, the North's first ballistic weapons testing activity since late June, which landed in waters off its east coast.

The joint exercises come days after South Korea, the United States and Japan detected the second North Korean missile test in days, part of ballistic missile testing this month that is banned by the United Nations.

Trump has sought to curtail the exercises before, suspending them entirely in 2018 during denuclearisation negotiations with Kim Jong Un, and the drills were scaled back again in 2020 during the Covid-19 pandemic.

After his 2018 meeting with Kim Jong Un in Singapore, Trump told reporters the United States would be stopping the war games to save a tremendous amount of money, unless and until future negotiations were not going as they should.

Trump's 16 August 2026 announcement came a day after he posted a photo of himself standing next to Kim Jong Un, writing that the two leaders get along great despite the unfriendly look in that particular picture.

Trump met the North Korean leader three times during his first term to discuss the country's nuclear programme, most recently in 2019, and has expressed interest in continuing those discussions since returning to office.
The Hill reported on 16 August 2026 that Trump said in a Truth Social post that he had told Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to substantially reduce the joint military exercises with South Korea.

South Korea's military said it fired warning shots after North Korean soldiers briefly crossed the military demarcation line, an incident that forced the North Korean soldiers to retreat, according to Reuters and Yonhap reporting dated 16 August 2026.

South Korea's President Lee proposed talks with Pyongyang on formally ending the Korean War and replacing the 1953 armistice with peace, a proposal Pyongyang snubbed as inter-Korean tensions flared ahead of the US-South Korea drills.
